displayName: Aura Code — VS Code Theme Changer: Glass, Backgrounds & Music
description: Turn VS Code into a glass window over your desktop (Wallpaper Engine too): animated backgrounds, video game fonts, one-click font installs and a music player with a real visualizer.
view.music.title: Music
view.music.name: Player
config.title: Aura Code
command.aura.pickImage: Use a custom image as background…
command.aura.setVisibility: Adjust VS Code visibility over the desktop
config.aura.background.markdownDescripti: Active background. A gradient from the catalog (`aurora`, `sunset`, `neon`…), `album` (music cover), `wallpaper` (glass over your desktop), `image` (see `#aura.customImage#`) or `none`.
config.aura.customImage.description: Path to a custom image (png, jpg, gif, webp) used when the background is 'image'.
config.aura.glassOpacity.description: Opacity of the panels (editor, sidebar, terminal…) over the background. Lower = more glass.
config.aura.backgroundBlur.description: Background blur in pixels (20-40 looks great for a glass effect with images).
config.aura.backgroundDim.description: Darkens the background so the code stays readable.
config.aura.music.enabled.description: Sync with the music playing on your PC (Spotify, YouTube, browser…). Windows only for now.
config.aura.music.reactivity.description: How strongly the background reacts to the beat.
config.aura.transparency.enumDescription: No real transparency: the chosen background is used.
Experimental (Windows 11): translucent window showing what is behind, blurred. Requires restarting VS Code.
Experimental (Windows 11): Mica material, a soft tint with your desktop color. Requires restarting VS Code.
config.aura.windowOpacity.description: VS Code visibility over your desktop with the 'My desktop (glass)' background. Higher = VS Code stands out more; 1 = opaque.
config.aura.uiFont.description: Font for the VS Code interface (sidebar, tabs, menus). Empty = default. It must be installed.
config.aura.fontApplyToTerminal.descript: When choosing a catalog font, also apply it to the integrated terminal (monospaced fonts only).
config.aura.debug.description: Saves a local technical report (~/.aura-code/diag.json) to diagnose drawing problems. It is never sent anywhere.
config.aura.port.description: Local port (127.0.0.1) Aura uses to send effects to the window. If you change it, run 'Aura: Enable effects' again.
config.aura.language.description: Aura language. 'auto' follows the VS Code display language.
config.aura.checkForUpdates.description: Check once a day on GitHub whether a new version of Aura is available and offer to install it.
